finalResult.nextParagraphText: “As I was getting to, if the Meditate skill is one originally made for gods to use, I think the one all mortals have is some kind of lesser version. Sure, it’s possible they just share a name, same as how Eversmile gave William a skill with Bloodline in the name just to mess with him, but you seriously don’t strike me as the type to do something like that. Hence why I believe the two are connected.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “But you still haven’t gotten to what lies beyond the gate.”
